origin.summary: Workout 1 of the 2013 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A 17-minute workout combining a descending burpee ladder with an ascending-load snatch ladder, finishing with max snatches at the heaviest weight for any remaining time.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2013/1 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
